en: Easy there, friend. Name's Ropeburn; I'm not like other Bandits. C'mon, let's have a chat.
Heya, Vulture. Holding strong?
What's new, scav?
Look who it is.
Oh, what a pleasure.
Guess I'll talk with the Bandit...
Need to talk to you.
We should talk.
Bandits know how to trade?
Looking to trade.
Anything worth trading?
Sure, why not.
Not usually my thing, but let's.
Can't hurt to try.
Been a while since I've done this.
Later, hotshot.
Don't sneak up on me next time.
I'll be around.
Go get your scraps, hustler.
Hope you find some extra shiny junk today.
You got a reason to be here?
You're staring too hard. Suspicious.
You're staring. We have a problem?
Picked up both transmissions.
I'm done spying around.
All done playing spy.
What was that...?
Did you hear that, Ropeburn?
That sudden transmission... How?
... How do you know my name?
Oh, hmm. We must've met at some point, done a job together or something, your name just slipped right out. I kinda tried a bunch of factions before deciding on the highwayman's life, after all.
I've been around, can't you tell? Look at the wrinkles! Ha. It's not a big deal either way, right, Vulture?
You're... A friendly Bandit, then?
I'm one-of-a-kind, what can I say. Though it's less like "friendly" and more like "neutral", so don't get ahead of yourself.
Only neutral Bandit I've ever seen.
Well, I tried different groups, meandered a lil' bit in life. Saw how folks operate to survive 'round here. Decided being a Bandit was easier – more simple.
Never was as much of a misanthrope as my colleagues, so you don't have to be on edge, Vulture. I got food, I got shelter. No reason to make trouble.
Not really winning me over.
Hey, it's actions that count, not words. And I could've started shooting soon as I saw you stumbling over here.
Wouldn't be your first time being shot by Bandits, would it? Ha, just a hunch.
What are you doing here?
Gettin' away from that hellscape at the Factories, for one. Svarog's a nice home base, we should've known some bastards woulda come knocking before long.

Could've been Palatines, but it's Gunners instead. They're even tougher. Spent five days holed up in a corner, fending off those gangsters, before I saw an opening to come here. Not eager to get back there.
What's Kharon?
Soldiers from the West. That's all we know, based on their looks, their gear. They've been rampaging through Zalesye... Soon as they got here from the Highway, they burned your Villa down.
Now they're movin' further and further West, into the Dola Oblast, but... What is it they came here to do, why the sudden show of violence? We got no clue, zilch.
What's with all the Mudlarks here?
C'mon, don't act like you don't know. Probably looking for the same thing they are... Everyone's tryin' to get to that bunker you just came out of. Find ourselves some... Compounds.
Thanks for openin' up a path for us, I guess. Although it's opened for those Gunners too... They might be coming this way now...
About this Kharon group...
Never mind; I have to go.
You've seen them up close?
Nah, just spied from afar, don't got a death wish. No getting up close to those guys without being spotted, they all got tools that see you comin' from a mile away.
Those soldiers come from a world that hasn't stopped in time like ours did. They're bound to have better toys. It's why we don't see their corpses lying around.
How come they've gone quiet?
After burnin' down your whole ghetto, I thought they'd be more... Active 'round here, too. But they just went straight to the Dola, and did their best to block the way over too...
Something wild's about to go down in the Oblast, scav. I'd stay away from there... Unless you want some revenge on the bastards or something.
Wonder if they're taking new recruits.
Ha! Good joke. One little peep of beefed-up infantry and we all get our career hopes up. No no no...
No, that group of soldiers is the world telling our Continent that we've lost the war. They couldn't possibly recruit us for anything other than slave labor. To the victor go the spoils.
Let's talk about something else.
There's no need for aggression, Vulture. Not all Bandits are shoot-on-sight, y'know? And you're drawing a lot of attention to yourself, so it's not like I didn't have a shot there.
We been trying to open that bunker door there for a while, and you just pop out like nothin'. Lemme guess – you were looking for Herb ingredients? Tryin' to have a trip?
... There's things I want to see again.
Hmm, had a taste of the afterlife or something? If I were the guessin' type, I'd say you look like you've seen one of them red floating Cores. Those will give you some wild visions.
Not your concern.
I get it, I don't judge. Had myself a trip recently, staring at this red, floating orb thing. Looked like one of them Cores, but even more powerful. Was thinking maybe you'd seen the same thing.
Yeah... Saw something just like that. A Core... But...

Haha, I knew it! Why else would a scav be so desperate to get their hands on them Herbs, like an old drunkard? It was probably after they burned your Villa down, no? The trick to see that type of Core is to go where dozens of folk are dying.
No... Why do you think that?

Oh, just a guess. Thought maybe one of them appeared after those soldiers from the West burned your Villa down. That's what causes that particular Core to show up, y'know? Concentrated murder. And then it disappears real fast.
But let's switch gears a bit. I think you're just the man I needed. Resourceful... Motivated. I know Vultures are all about doin' odd jobs to scrape by. Welp, I got a gig for you.
I don't wanna hear it.
You'll find it difficult to get out of here without some help, y'know.
... Let's hear it.
This thing back here, you know what it is? Radio gear. You know those soldiers who invaded Zalesye, right? Kharon. This is a pretty modern radio one of them "dropped".

It's in our interest to know what those fuckers are up to. Already massacred you Vultures – could be coming for us next. Problem is, they've been moving further West – into the Dola – and out of this thing's range.

I've set up a couple of signal repeaters around town. Could take the radio for a spin, pick up some transmissions, relay back the info. Then rendezvous somewhere safe... The Burned Villa, maybe... To stash the radio and split up. You down?
Spying on those who burned my shack? I'm in.
Atta boy. Ask me any deets you need to know.
I want nothing to do with any of that.
Of course. I mean, you'd be gettin' back at them a lil' bit, but... Feel free to strut around a little before you change your mind.
I have some questions first.
Well if you weren't curious you wouldn't be the man for the job, so shoot.
If it's a simple job...
Why don't I go, right? Don't know if you've noticed, but there's a bit of an ongoing conflict 'tween Bandits and Gunners over at Svarog, right around the corner there.
I finally got away from it. Here at the Highway, no one bothers to look for me. But if I leave, and start wavin' a radio around... Too much attention, man. I'd rather you do it.
What's in it for me?
Well, you're tryin' to get your hands on some Mudlark herbs, no? That'll cost ya. What if I covered those? We're talkin' a nice, juicy reward for a pretty standard gig, here.
Hmm...
Come on now, don't try to bluff with me. You scavs are always taking gigs for like, a lump of old bread and a bandage. I'm offerin' something nicer.
Already got the money.
Well then, get the money to get some other stuff after you score some psychedelics. C'mon, where's your sense of adventure, man?
How do I use the radio?
Just turn it on and keep it close to you when you think you're getting near my repeater.
You'll only hear white noise at first – radio static. But you should be able to sort of gradually tune into a discernible transmission eventually.
Where do you need me to go?

I've placed two signal repeaters for you to find, both on checkpoints way West of here... One of them you can find at the opposite end of these train tracks. The other one's further Southwest from there.

I can monitor some of the radio's activity from here, so I'll know when the repeaters have activated. Then we can rendezvous at the Burned Villa... I'll pick some random tent there to hide in, just find me.
I don't have any more questions.
Then on you go, please!
My decision...
Howdy, Vulture, how's the investigation going? Pick up anything good?
Still working on it.
C'mon, I didn't make those repeaters that hard to find. Time is of the essence, man. Those soldiers are moving further and further West everyday.
Had some questions first.
Good job, Vulture. Before you stash the radio, tell me – what did you overhear? Spill it and I'll give you your reward.
(Something about the "mines"...)
I see. Respat Mines out West, that's their goal? That doesn't mean much to me, but I guess it's good news. Means he's moving away from us Bandits, and probably won't bother us.
(Something about gathering Cores...)
They're gathering up Cores? "Blood Cores", they said? Shit, I think this has to be about those special ones that you and I've both seen. The vision-inducing ones...

Good for you, maybe – if having a repeat of those visions is what you want. You could try tailing those Kharon guys. Though I doubt their objective is as simple as "trippin' out after some mass-murder".
(They're blocking the checkpoints...)
Ah, but of course they are. Can't let pesky folks like you and I hinder their plans, even if just by accident.
That might be good for us, too. Keeps the trouble at the Dola instead of here. Wouldn't want more Vultures burning, would we?
Anyway, you did good. Here's your reward. Now go – stash that thing already, and we'll split up pronto.
A message directly from their leader, huh... He knew we've been snooping around; you were careless, scav. He's gotta be nearby... Maybe at the Swamps, from the sounds I heard.

Listen, Vulture. Seems to me you've got yourself a shot at the king, here. If I were you, I'd prepare myself to finish him off. Get a little revenge, break out of the rut you've been in, y'know? But that's just me.
No way I'll chase trouble. Going for the Herb.
Back to Plan A, huh? Those visions won't get you anywhere, but hey, I got no skin in the game. Either way, make sure that radio's hidden well. We'll part ways for now, but...
What would that get me? He's just one man.
I guess you'd rather go back to the old cycle of looting random scraps while hoping for a one-way ticket to Wyraj... Like every other Vulture, huh. Well, I still have high hopes for you.
I'm willing to bet we'll meet again, sooner or later. Unless you get yourself killed, we can be partners-in-crime some other time. See you around... Rodion.
